pattern.name: com_initialization
pattern.python_code:
import pythoncom import win32com.client
def initialize_autocad(): """Initialize COM and create AutoCAD application""" pythoncom.CoInitialize() try: acad = win32com.client.Dispatch("AutoCAD.Application") return acad except Exception as e: print(f"Failed to initialize AutoCAD: {e}") return None
